summary.name: heyCLI
summary.one_liner: heyCLI is a Linux terminal helper that translates plain-English requests into shell commands, triggered by starting with the word "hey".
use_cases: running terminal tasks in plain English
learning shell commands by describing goals
speeding up everyday command line work
summary.what_it_does:
The page describes heyCLI as a tool that translates natural language into Linux commands. Users begin a request with the word "hey" and then describe the task they want done in the terminal. The page says to try it by following instructions in its GitHub repository. It also offers an email signup for feature updates and a contact address for questions or issues. The page gives no further technical detail about how commands are generated or executed.</what_it_does>
